d:
The Nuggets defeated the Pelicans, 116-108 tonight in New Orleans. Nikola Jokić contributed a team-high 26 points to go with 10 assists 8 rebounds and 3 steals, with Jamal Murray of the Nuggets adding an additional 23 points (9-16 FG) in the game. Zion Williamson finished with a team-high 24 points along with 6 rebounds for the Pelicans in the losing effort. The Nuggets improve their record to 7-4 with the win, while the Pelicans fall to 4-10 for the season.
